component.name: Furius ISO Mount
component.summary: Mount ISO, IMG, BIN, MDF and NRG disc images

description.p: Furius ISO Mount is a simple application to mount disc images without burning them to a physical disc. It supports ISO, IMG, BIN, MDF and NRG images.

ul.li: Mount and unmount images with FUSE (fuseiso) or loop devices (udisks2)
MD5 and SHA1 checksum calculation with progress and cancellation
Image burning with brasero or wodim
Interface in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Italian, Japanese, Russian and Chinese

description.p: This application is a PyQt6 fork of the original Furius ISO Mount by Dean Harris.
